title: A developer adds an invoice fetcher that reads its billing key from the environment and handles outside failures. Expected: not flagged, since no secret is typed into the code.
diff:
--- a/src/billing/invoices.py
+++ b/src/billing/invoices.py
@@ -5,2 +5,13 @@
 BILLING_URL = "https://billing.example.com/api"
 BILLING_API_KEY = os.environ["BILLING_API_KEY"]
+REFUND_TOKEN = os.environ.get("REFUND_TOKEN", "")
+
+
+def fetch_invoice(invoice_id: str) -> dict:
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {BILLING_API_KEY}"}
+    try:
+        resp = requests.get(f"{BILLING_URL}/invoices/{invoice_id}", headers=headers, timeout=10)
+        resp.raise_for_status()
+    except requests.RequestException as exc:
+        raise InvoiceUnavailable(invoice_id) from exc
+    return resp.json()
